description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Presentation' class, which extends the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule' to implement the XHTML 1.1 Presentation Module. It sets up elements related to presentation markup such as 'hr', 'sub', 'sup', 'b', 'big', 'i', 'small', and 'tt', with some elements marked for formatting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Presentation
classes.description: A class representing the XHTML 1.1 Presentation Module, defining presentation-related markup elements for the HTML Purifier framework.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the presentation elements such as hr, sub, sup, b, big, i, small, and tt, defining their content model and formatting options.
